artifact_role: durable curated Phase A decision evidence

signal.source: Issue #59 TradingView Macro Pressure Map V6.6 parity log
signal.axis_audit_sampling: every 100th derived raw row plus final row
signal.regime_semantics: frozen raw GPI x raw IPI 3x3 core regime
signal.fcpi_role: preserved in deterministic raw-axis audit and independent reconstruction check; not used to select Phase A regime cells

outcomes.price_semantics: Yahoo Finance yfinance auto_adjust=True adjusted Close
outcomes.inference: deterministic bootstrap 95% intervals on horizon-embargoed starts within each regime

temporal_stability.development_segment: 2007-01-04 through 2019-12-31; forward price panel truncated at 2019-12-31 so horizons cannot leak into 2020
temporal_stability.post2019_segment: 2020-01-01 through the frozen signal cutoff; reused exploratory evidence, not untouched OOS

selection_caveat.interpretation: Nominal bootstrap intervals are hypothesis-generating only. They do not establish a confirmed discovery after post-selection/multiple-comparison search.

selected_phase_b_hypothesis.comparison: SPY total return minus TLT total return
selected_phase_b_hypothesis.interpretation: This is the most coherent candidate for an isolated Phase B equity-over-duration override, not a statistically confirmed relationship.

secondary_exploratory_hypothesis.comparison: SPY total return minus GLD total return
secondary_exploratory_hypothesis.interpretation: Gold-over-equity direction is coherent across both eras and all three horizons but remains exploratory and weaker than the selected Reflation candidate.

important_instability_example.comparison: TLT total return minus GLD total return
important_instability_example.interpretation: The relative duration-versus-gold preference changes materially by era; neither 'slowdown means long duration' nor 'slowdown means gold' should be hard-coded from the full-history winner table.

phase_a_decision.reason: Only 9 of 27 regime-horizon leaders match across eras, and post-2019 GLD dominates 22 of 27 cells versus only 7 development cells, showing large secular-era dependence.
phase_a_decision.phase_b_boundary: Use a small neutral-default template set and test one pre-frozen, economically interpretable Reflation equity-over-duration override first. Treat the result as exploratory reused-history evidence because the hypothesis was selected from Phase A. Do not optimize nine separate regime weights from the full history.

evidence_boundary: All Phase A historical signal evidence is reused/development/exploratory. The post-2019 segment is not newly untouched OOS. Nominal bootstrap intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
